visual_action: A slideshow of official portraits of six Republican members of Congress. Each slide features a quote from the person expressing concern about healthcare, followed by text stating they voted for "Trump's budget bill anyway." The video concludes with a black screen listing the number of Americans in each state who will supposedly lose healthcare under this bill.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue, only a background music track.
audio_music: A somber, melancholic acoustic song with male vocals plays throughout. The lyrics include "the truth hurts, so I lied to you," which serves to frame the featured politicians as liars. The music continues instrumentally over the final data slide, maintaining a serious and mournful tone.
editing_pacing: Simple slideshow with slow cuts between static images.
central_claim: Several Republican congresspeople are hypocrites for publicly stating they would protect healthcare and then voting for a budget bill from Donald Trump that will strip healthcare from 17 million Americans.
intended_effect: To generate anger towards the featured Republican politicians and Donald Trump, and to portray them as liars who harm their constituents.
